t.zh: 两句话能互相推出，说的就是同一件事，这叫<wiki-ref to="equivalence"></wiki-ref>。「¬¬下雨」和「下雨」就是一对。
t.en: Two sentences that each give the other say the same thing: they are in <wiki-ref to="equivalence"></wiki-ref>. “¬¬it rains” and “it rains” are such a pair.

t.zh: 两个方向都证出后，合成一个元件，元件上切换方向。
t.en: Once both directions are proved, they make one part that switches between the two.

hint.zh: 手里有一条规则正好去掉两个 ¬。
hint.en: One rule you hold takes exactly two ¬s off.
